data.text:
San Juan City Mayor Francis Zamora backs MMDA's appeal for no mall-wide sales on weekdays to help ease traffic during the holiday rush.
 
"[A]ng policy ng MMDA pagdating sa mall-wide sales ngayong Kapaskuhan ay huwag mag-mall-wide sale 'pag weekdays (Monday to Friday) dahil kasabay nito ang pumapasok sa trabaho pag weekdays," said Zamora, who is also Metro Manila Council President.
 
"Okay lang sa kanila 'pag weekends (Saturday and Sunday) kasi less ang nagtatrabaho compared to weekdays. Basta mayroong maayos na traffic management plan ang malls at well-coordinated ito sa mga LGUs," he added.
